transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the weekly sustainment review. I need updates from each of you before I can sign off on the disposition plan for the materials in the holding area. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders awaiting disposition. Environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation reps -- please go ahead and report your updates so we can get these items moving.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the environmental side, I confirmed this morning that the used oil consists of exactly 18 drums accepted by the contracted recycling service, with pickup available on 26 June. The contractor confirmation is in the environmental file, but I should note it has not yet been added to the S-4 disposition worksheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Major, on the maintenance side: I counted exactly 24 cases of vehicle batteries in the holding area. The approved battery vendor requires no more than 12 cases per pallet, so this shipment must use exactly two pallets with battery-hazard labels. The count and packing instruction are documented in the motor-pool inspection folder, but I have not yet sent them to logistics.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. On the medical-logistics side: I confirmed that the expired medical cold packs must be returned to Medical Supply rather than discarded locally. The return appointment is set for 25 June and is on the clinic supply calendar, but I should note it has not yet been cross-referenced with the holding-area disposition plan.
